D/ [IMP] C CARAVSIVS P F AVG

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Carausius (286-293), C mint, Reece period 14. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [IMP] C CARAVSIVS P F AVG. Reverse description: Figure standing left, with ?standard in left hand. Reverse inscription: possibly [VIRTVS] AVG. In exergue: C. Diameter: 22.4mm, Weight: 2.70gms, die axis: 6. This coin has been considered for Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC - it is not possible to confirm identification from image
